newsitem.title: USA: Republic Bancorp sells four Mich. branches.
newsitem.headline: Republic Bancorp sells four Mich. branches.

text.p: Republic Bancorp Inc said Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to sell four southern Michigan branches with total deposits of $59 million to Hillsdale County National Bank for undisclosed terms.
The sale, expected to close in the second quarter pending regulatory approval includes the deposits and offices in Hanover, Litchfield, Somerset Center and Spring Arbor, Mich.
"The sale of these offices creates an opportunity for Republic Bank to expand its deposit gathering network in other areas of the state," Republic Chairman Jerry Campbell said in a statement.
